C-MEETING-CONTINUITY-347.Summary: Complete issue 347: durable transfer and editing of department meetings, complete template exports and targeted desktop/mobile acceptance.
C-MEETING-CONTINUITY-347.Problem: The published branch is incomplete: transfer UI and API wiring are missing, and an accidental rewrite of protocol persistence must be replaced with the exact main implementation plus the narrowly scoped transfer guard.

Goals.Goal: Keep the same agenda and decision identities, source evidence, plan links, deadlines and generated files when transferring questions or changing a meeting date.
Make network retries idempotent, rollback partial writes and preserve existing workspace permission boundaries.
Export the complete agenda or selected extract with every resolution, responsible person and due date; preserve previous DOCX bytes and template version metadata.
Complete UI/API integration and prove normal desktop/mobile interactions without forced clicks, skipped assertions or increased timeouts.

Constraints.Constraint: Exact base main is d094b82a6c292ab2d4b3f0981963ef4ccf323c52; issue 347 is the acceptance authority.
No SQL schema, applied migration, storage engine, backup/restore, auth model, installer, dependency or version changes. SQLite remains schema 31.
Immutable source versions, blobs, raw extraction and evidence remain intact; a transfer writes an audit record and changes only question ownership/order plus derived search and links.
Keep the established persistProtocol implementation from main; add only recognition of a previously transferred source question.
No new motion, no adaptive learning of transfer destinations or consequential actions.
Use ordinary project CI once for check/docs/unit/smoke, and one path-scoped browser workflow without repeating unit tests.

NonGoals.NonGoal: New release or changes to offline installation.
Redesign the full meetings interface or change department-specific template rules.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Creating or rescheduling a meeting selects its year; reload, plan archive and question transfer do not lose the meeting or its history.
Transfers preserve question, decisions, evidence and plan source IDs; both agendas are renumbered and links/search identify the destination.
Repeated requests and late retries after a later transfer are safe; invalid or cross-workspace destinations and forced transaction failures do not partially modify data.
Reprocessing the original protocol does not recreate a manually transferred question; its review exceptions follow its identity.
DOCX contains every resolution with responsibility/deadline and exact selected template metadata; old generated bytes remain unchanged.
Desktop and mobile pass creation, transfer after lost response, date/year correction, reload and generation using real application routes.
Ordinary CI, targeted browser and GRACE final lint/scope are green before expected-head squash merge; main then runs only post-merge smoke.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Issue 347 regression suites, exact-head GitHub Actions results and unchanged SQLite migration tree.
